content.comment_body: I have a question: Is it possible for [company_name] [product_name] to transmit data faster between devices? Currently, data is sent in about 90 ms. Can the polling interval over the internet be made shorter?

analysis.insight_summary: A user is attempting to improve the data transfer speed between two [company_name] [product_name], specifically to reduce the 90 ms send time or enable a quicker internet polling cycle. The response clarifies that neither the hardware nor firmware allows changing or improving these speeds for [product_name], highlighting a built-in technical limitation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects it should be possible to speed up data transmission or make the polling interval between [product_name] units shorter.
